import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Define the target schema columns and their types
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Data types for enforcing target schema
    dtype_map = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',  # Use pandas nullable integer type to allow missing values if any
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    }

    # List to hold dataframes from each source
    dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load each source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Ensure all target columns exist in source (they do as per given schema)
        # If any column is missing, create it with NaNs (not expected here)
        for col in target_columns:
            if col not in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.NA

        # Select only the target columns in the correct order
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Convert columns to target dtypes
        # For string columns, convert to pandas string dtype
        for col, dtype in dtype_map.items():
            if dtype == 'string':
                df[col] = df[col].astype('string')
            elif dtype == 'Int64':
                # Nullable integer type, convert safely
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
            elif dtype == 'int64':
                # For tripduration, convert to int64, coercing errors to NaN then fill or drop if needed
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype('int64')
            elif dtype == 'float64':
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype('float64')

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: If needed, sort by starttime or any other column
    # target_df = target_df.sort_values(by='starttime').reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
